column3: Do you inspect incoming materials or products for quality before accepting delivery?
column5: Defective inputs enter production undetected; returns and rework costs increase

column3: Do you have written contracts with your key suppliers covering quality expectations and penalties?
column5: No legal recourse when suppliers fail; no accountability for quality shortfalls

column3: Do you evaluate supplier performance at least annually?
column5: Underperforming suppliers retained by default; no systematic supply chain improvement

column3: Do you consider any basic ESG requirements when selecting suppliers (e.g. legal registration, basic labour compliance)?
column5: Exposure to reputational risk if supplier practices are exposed; future buyer audit risks

column3: Are key production or warehouse processes documented in standard operating procedures (SOPs)?
column5: Quality inconsistency; rework costs; high retraining cost when staff leave

column3: Do workers have clearly defined roles and responsibilities for each process step?
column5: Errors and gaps in accountability; confusion leads to product defects and accidents

column3: Do supervisors track productivity metrics (e.g. output per shift, defect rate, downtime) regularly?
column5: Productivity loss goes unnoticed; inability to identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies

column3: Is there a systematic process for identifying and addressing operational bottlenecks?
column5: Recurring problems persist indefinitely; staff frustration; output unreliable

column3: Do all workers have written employment contracts compliant with Vietnamese labour law?
column5: Labour inspection fines; disputes over pay/termination; reputational damage

column3: Are working hours, overtime, and rest days tracked and within legal limits?
column5: Overtime pay disputes; risk of labour violation findings during audits

column3: Do you have and enforce workplace health & safety procedures relevant to your operations?
column5: Workplace accidents; worker compensation liability; shutdown risk after incident

column5: Unexpressed grievances escalate; sudden collective action or external complaints

column3: Do you conduct safety inductions for all new workers before they start work?
column5: New workers are highest-risk group for accidents; liability without documented induction

column5: Legal penalties; worker grievances; discovery during labour inspections

column5: Legal discrimination risk; limited talent access; reputational damage if exposed
